title: QueueBatchStatus
description:
The live batch a project is running.

A batch is execution state, not pipeline state: it exists only while the service is
walking the list, and every row's own progress still comes from its checkpoint. A
restart therefore reports no batch rather than resuming a stale one.

active.description: Whether a batch is running right now.

current_video_id.description: The video the batch is running, when one is active.

project_id.description: The project whose queue the batch belongs to.

remaining.description: How many videos have not started yet.

total.description: How many videos the batch was asked to run.
